description: This PHP class 'FormatWithSkill' implements a value formatter interface to fetch and format skill names based on skill IDs, utilizing a service class 'SkillService' to retrieve skill data from a data source.

classes.name: FormatWithSkill
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to format skill IDs into skill names using a service class.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill entity by ID and returns its name if found; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the SkillService instance used to fetch skill data.
